What’s Anya Mind, my friends? I'm a Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist. I love the work that I do with individuals, couples, and families and am extending that work here on YouTube! Whether you're an emerging therapist, a therapy lover, or just looking to create healthy relationship-- I'm here for you and with you. Join me as I take you through the ups and downs of my experiences and hopefully help you on your own journey. Welcome to my little therapy corner!
For sponsorships and collaborations, please email stephanya@harpers.us
